description: Recommended downstream read order for agents consuming the AROORO Admin luxury dashboard design library.

tokenSource.rule: Read css.json to understand tokens; link colors_and_type.css at runtime. Do not parse colors_and_type.css for token understanding when css.json is available.

priority.purpose: First source for DOM/CSS fidelity and anatomy
Intent, variants, states, and semantic type candidates
Fallback raw evidence when preview is missing or insufficient (not present in this library)

readOrder.purpose: Skill entry point — brand context, file map, concrete design essentials. Read first to grasp visual identity without opening other files.
Rich brand narrative — content fundamentals, voice & tone, visual foundations (color, typography, spacing, radius, shadow), component patterns, caveats.
Structured JSON token representation — primary source for programmatic token understanding (colors, typography, spacing, radius, shadows, sizing).
Runtime CSS variables — link into HTML/prototypes; do not read for understanding when css.json exists. Contains :root tokens, .dark overrides, and typography utility classes.
Component index — enumerates all components, cross-component patterns, and library summary. Establishes the component inventory.
Aggregated component CSS auto-extracted from preview pages — sectioned per component (Button, Card, Table, Chart, Navigation, Sidebar). Reference for exact component styling.
Button preview — DOM/CSS fidelity source for pill primary, row actions, toggle, and pagination variants.
Button component contract — intent, variant dimensions, state coverage, anatomy.
Card preview — white card with hairline border and stat card (tinted icon + number + trend).
Card component contract — anatomy, structure patterns, usage hints.
Data Table preview — editorial table with eyebrow headers, thumbnail cells, pill statuses, Inter amounts.
Data Table component contract — pattern model, coverage matrix, representative variants.
Chart preview — CSS-only gradient bar chart and conic-gradient donut with center hole + legend.
Chart component contract — anatomy, CSS-only rendering patterns.
Navigation preview — top header with breadcrumb, search pill, notification icon, user chip.
Navigation component contract — anatomy, structure patterns.
Sidebar preview — deep forest green gradient, gold active indicator, 72px collapse behavior.
Sidebar component contract — anatomy, collapse model, active state semantics.

notes: This library has no components/_evidence/ directory; component resolution uses preview HTML first, then components/{slug}.json.
All color, radius, spacing, and typography values originate from colors_and_type.css / css.json. No values should be hallucinated.
Font families: Cormorant Garamond (display/eyebrow), Noto Serif SC (headings), Noto Sans SC (body), Inter (numbers).
